text: They buried their son. <break time="0.8s" /> In a large cemetery about two miles away. <break time="0.8s" /> And they came back to a house. <break time="0.8s" /> Full of silence. <break time="0.8s" /> Days passed slowly. <break time="0.8s" /> And the old couple seemed to be waiting. <break time="0.8s" /> For something else to happen. <break time="0.8s" /> About a week later. <break time="0.8s" /> Missus White suddenly woke in the night. <break time="0.8s" /> And cried out. <break time="0.8s" /> The paw, The monkeys paw. <break time="0.8s" /> She said that they still had two wishes left. <break time="0.8s" /> And she begged her husband. <break time="0.8s" /> To wish their son alive again. <break time="0.8s" /> Mister White was afraid. <break time="0.8s" /> Because Herbert had been dead for ten days. <break time="0.8s" /> And had been badly hurt. <break time="0.8s" /> In the accident. <break time="0.8s" /> If you saw him now. <break time="0.8s" /> You would be even more frightened. <break time="0.8s" /> He said. <break time="0.8s" /> But his wife would not listen. <break time="0.8s" /> He went down alone. <break time="0.8s" /> To the dark parlor. <break time="0.8s" /> Where the paw lay. <break time="0.8s" /> On the shelf above the fireplace. <break time="0.8s" /> Returning to the bedroom. <break time="0.8s" /> The old man raised the paw and said. <break time="0.8s" /> I wish my son alive again. <break time="0.8s" /> The paw fell to the floor. <break time="0.8s" /> And the candle soon went out. <break time="0.8s" /> But nothing happened. <break time="0.8s" /> So they went back to bed. <break time="0.8s" /> Lying awake in the darkness. <break time="0.8s" /> They listened to the clock ticking. <break time="0.8s" /> And the stairs creaking. <break time="0.8s" /> In the quiet house.
